purpose: Assess prior Development/Train family overlap for one prospective fresh Development candidate from the frozen metadata sample before opening its issue body, source, tests, or patch.

comparison_scope.heldout: Exclude Held-out rows before semantic comparison. Do not inspect, print, or report Held-out identifiers or contents.
candidate_material: the single candidate identity and row bound above
issue-family metadata and changed paths in the frozen metadata sample
historical_material: the prior frozen Development/Train inventory and candidate assessments
the two Development events in the frozen post-attempt exposure append

decision_rules.label: DIRECT_IDENTITY_OVERLAP
decision_rules.rule: Same repository and upstream PR/task identity as a previously exposed Development or Train task.

decision_rules.label: SAME_TASK_FAMILY
decision_rules.rule: Metadata documents the same underlying defect or behavioral contract in the same component; changed-path overlap corroborates but does not alone establish family identity.

decision_rules.label: POSSIBLE_FAMILY_OVERLAP
decision_rules.rule: Metadata suggests a shared subsystem or contract, but evidence is insufficient to conclude the same defect family.

decision_rules.label: NO_PRIOR_FAMILY_OVERLAP_FOUND
decision_rules.rule: No direct identity or same-family match is found among available Development/Train exposure metadata; this does not establish pretraining independence.

decision_rules.label: INDETERMINATE
decision_rules.rule: Available exposure metadata is incomplete or lacks enough issue/path detail to apply the preceding criteria.

report_requirements: verify every frozen input and the canonical candidate-row hash
record repository, upstream PR identity, issue family, changed paths, prior match category, rationale, and confidence
report only Development/Train comparison rows and omit Held-Out identifiers
state whether metadata supports proceeding to source qualification, without assigning a split
prohibited_actions: opening or fetching the candidate issue body, source, tests, patch, or grader artifacts
running tests, baselines, or task environments
split assignment or changing any historical exposure ledger
using Held-Out data or reporting Held-Out identifiers
claiming absence of public pretraining exposure
authorization: METADATA_ONLY_OVERLAP_REVIEW; source qualification, split assignment, testing, and inference are not authorized by this protocol
